text:
ella (AE): Opening PeninsulaBank POC. They want Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (users + nested groups), RBAC mapping to tenant roles, DNS TXT domain verification, and a Private/VPC option for PHI. Need feasibility + a short runbook + a high-level Dedicated vs Private delta by EOD Fri. Looping in @raj and @mina.

raj (SE): Quick clarifying Qs: SP + IdP SAML both needed? Any admin API mTLS planned? Expected directory size?

mina (Solutions Eng): Both SP and IdP. Admin API via mTLS. Directory ~20k users, ~1.8k groups. Cutover plan shows a ~55 req/s sustained SCIM window for 2 hours.

jon (Security): PHI -> require customer-managed KMS and SIEM forwarding. HSM optional but adds ~3-5 weeks. Confirm retention (90d vs 365d) because pricing differs. Also need redaction options for PII in assertion logs.

ella (AE): Buyer asked: committed ~9M tokens/mo and ~600k SCIM ops onboarding. Can we guarantee the 55 req/s/2h burst and what's the uplift for Dedicated vs Private (one-time + monthly)?

raj (SE): Default SCIM tenant limit is 10 req/s. Options: bulk CSV import (preferred), scheduled burst (ops-approved + 72h notice), or managed ingestion by onboarding team (fee). For a scheduled 55 req/s/2h window we can approve with monitoring and safety cutoff; rough uplift for that window ~1.25x. Dedicated = baseline + ~20% SLA premium; Private = larger upfront + license/support. Need committed qps to firm numbers.

mina (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a short runbook covering SAML flows we support, SCIM bulk endpoint and chunking guidance (recommend 250-500 users), group->role regex examples, and DNS TXT verification steps. Will include an example curl for bulk import. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

raj (SE): Example mapping we'll include:

# map Okta group "team-platform-eu" -> role "platform-eu"
rule: {group_regex: "^team-(.*)$", role_template: "\1"}

And SCIM bulk note: use /scim/v2/Users/bulk with batch sizes ~250	600KB payloads to control memory.

jon (Security): I'll prepare a minimal compliance checklist: KMS options (customer-managed KMS vs HSM), SIEM HEC endpoint config, retention tiers with price impact, and required attestations.

ops-bot: ticket#14222 created: "PeninsulaBank onboarding window" assigned to oncall-ops. Note: scheduled bursts require 72h notice and an ops-run safety cutoff.

ella (AE): Action items: @mina runbook + examples by EOD tomorrow; @raj perf sim with 2KB/user and confirm 55 req/s safety and 1-page Dedicated vs Private delta; @jon compliance checklist. I'll ask PeninsulaBank for a sample SCIM CSV and their preferred cutover window. :thumbsup:
